items:
Spectacular gulf views and observation deck, 2.5 blocks from the beach
Multiple identical houses available next door to each other.

New construction that is a professionally decorated, luxury property completed March 2019. Sleeping arrangements include four king bedrooms plus a bunk room that has four queen mattresses so the house comfortably sleeps and entertains 12-16 people. First floor has a den with 65” tv, kitchen with professional stainless appliances and white quartz, half bath, laundry room with full size Samsung front loading steam washer and dryer, and a king bedroom. Second floor has two king bedrooms plus bathrooms and the bunk room which has four queen mattresses. Third floor has a king bedroom and bath plus a den with a 70” tv and an arcade machine. Third floor porch is a covered outdoor kitchen and seating area with a tv plus a spiral staircase that leads to the fourth floor, rooftop observation deck that has amazing gulf and sunset views.

This new neighborhood is being built out as an 11-house community that is themed to blend in with the new surrounding developments on the east end of 30A. Exteriors are white, hard-coat stucco with every house having unique shutter colors. Interiors have shaker cabinets, white quartz, professional kitchen appliances, nickel gap shiplap wall siding, built in bunks, hardwood floors, soft LED lighting, NEST Thermostats, and all the items you need to be comfortable during your stay such as a Dyson Animal cordless vacuum.

Why Grove at Inlet? This new neighborhood has you in the middle of everything but it isn’t as congested as surrounding communities. Once you unpack the groceries, it is possible to park your car and not use it for the rest of your week. Here are some of the attractions within two blocks of the house:

Beach access – It is only a four minute, two and half block (approximately 460 steps) walk to the beach. What you will come to love about this South Wall Street beach access is that it is a Walton County neighborhood beach access point. This means that there is no parking for vehicles. The only people at this access point either walked here or biked here so it is a much quieter and less crowded beach than neighboring communities. There is a second public beach access point with parking and restrooms, approximately 760 steps away.

Rosemary Beach – There is only one long block between us and the western border of Rosemary Beach but it is a further walk (approximately 1400 steps) to get all the way over to the Town Center at Rosemary Beach where there is great food, shopping, and seasonal activities open to the public. Restaurants include Amavida Coffee & Tea, Cowgirl Kitchen, Edward’s Food & Wine, Havana Beach Bar & Grill in the Pearl Hotel, La Crema Tapas & Chocolate, Pescado Rooftop Bar & Seafood Grill, Restaurant Paradis, and the Sugar Shack. Rosemary Beach is home to a popular farmers market every Sunday from 9am-1pm at Barrett Square. Like tennis? Rosemary Beach’s Racquet Club is one of the top 75 tennis destinations in the world and they are open to the public. Contact the Racquet Club to book a reservation.

Food – Donut Hole, Shades Bar & Grill, Destin Ice Market 30A, Big Bad Breakfast at the Pointe, 30Avenue (Amici 30A Italian Kitchen, Barbacoa Mexican Grill, Cuvee 30A, Freshii, Great American Cookies, Marble Slab Creamery) are all within a two block radius of the house.

Shopping – 30Avenue includes 30A Olive Oil, Design, L.A. Green, Lighting Etc., Love 2 Run, Margaret Ellen Bridal, Mingle, Outpost, Otium, Shades Sunglasses & Casual Apparel, Shimmering Seas, Willow + Mercer, and the 30A Medical Spa. Crossings at Inlet Beach includes DRIFT Home & Gifts | 30A On the Coast, Tassels Furniture & Design, Beach Blinds, Draperies & More, Lightning by Lavonne, and Rug Island. Rosemary Beach has Bombora Sun & Surf, Curate A Collaboration with Vinings Gallery, Gigi’s Fabulous Kids’ Fashions and Toys, Hissyfits Boutique, Moonpize a ladies shoe and gift boutique, Pish Posh Patchouli’s, Rosemary Beach Trading Company, and SEA Contemporary Art Space.

Convenience – Destin Ice house across the street is an upscale grocery market for Fresh Gulf Seafood, Prime Meats, Fine Wines and Craft Beers, Gourmet Cheeses, Deli and Prepared Foods, and more that is open 9am-8pm daily. There is also a UPS Store across the street at Inlet Crossing. Gas station and convenience store are within a block of the house.

No smoking in the house nor on patios, observation decks, or yards.

Come see why Inlet Beach is becoming the best place to be in South Walton and on 30A!

Construction – it is hard to find anywhere on 30A that doesn’t have any construction going on! This neighborhood consists of 11 houses. The first seven are complete and none are currently under construction. Houses 8 and 9 are estimated to break ground during September 2020 for a summer 2021 delivery. We will do our best to minimize the disruptions to our guests and keep everything contained but please be aware of this potential inconvenience. The common pool is complete.

Reviews - Please see sister properties for reviews and availability. VRBO listings 1288308, 1262353, 1622778, 1620573, 1622323, 1767490, and 1885228.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

responses.response: We work hard to provide great houses so that guests can focus on creating family memories. While most guests enjoy their stay, some just appear unhappy. Upon arrival the guest was unhappy. Within 3 minutes of messaging me, I met them to walk the house. The complaint was that it had a dented trash can; I offered to replace it. Then there was a paint chip on a handrail - I offered to repaint. They complained about the age of the house (every one of my listings has the house construction date listed in the description). They refused both the trash can replacement and paint touch up. I couldn't tell if they wanted to negotiate rates upon arrival or were just unhappy with their selection. I asked what I could do to make them happy and they said they wanted to be gulf front in Rosemary Beach and immediately showed me the house they wanted. At 6PM on a Friday, I called the management company that operated the gulf front house and no one answered. I tracked down and called the owner of the other management company to get the guest in with an early check in. I volunteered over 20 hours of my time with this guest so they could have an amazing beach weekend. Feel free to read the VRBO review on the Rosemary Beach Pitot House from this same person in October 2024 and you will see an even more horrible review on that amazing house and an amazing response from that management company identifying the problem as the guest and not multiple houses. Unfortunately there was no pleasing this one.
